column1: # Controls. Each row changes ONE point of ONE extracted source, and both
#   ruby    scene.rb must stop refusing to agree -- the extraction no longer
#           reproduces the original Full executor's screen.
#   kernel  the CORE object built from the mutated source must no longer
#           reproduce the screen the original produced.
# A control that passed would mean the comparison cannot see that part of the
# computation, which is the only way a byte-for-byte check can be vacuous. The
# lane also asserts that each row changes exactly one occurrence and exactly
# one line, so a row cannot quietly break more than it claims.
